name: NetMirror
description: NetMirror (netmirror.center) - Netflix-style catalog: Bollywood, Hollywood, Anime & Reality TV, heavy on Hindi content. Signed direct-file servers per title/episode (R2 + quality-labeled MP4s, up to 1080p). v6: fixed the install-time crash (a header constant called the geo helper before its constants existed) and the site domain now follows the selected mirror. v5: rate-limit friendly (top-3 links per server).
